brain.commentary: Cross-asset stress, uniformly modest conviction, weak composites, and elevated downside tails warrant a defensive overlay. BTC is the most resilient signal but remains only mildly constructive. ETH and SOL longs are fragile due to negative alpha, high beta/volatility, and unfavorable expected shortfall. BCH, DOGE, and LTC lack supportive signals. ETC is not actionable: zero price, liquidity, volatility, and risk statistics indicate a likely data-quality or marketability failure.
